executivo.nota: Leis: as 203 leis ordinárias e complementares com data a partir de 1º/1/2025 cadastradas no SAPL da Câmara, venham de quem vierem (a prefeitura sanciona quase todas). Vetos: as mensagens de veto (total ou parcial) que a prefeitura mandou à Câmara a partir de 1º/1/2025, cadastradas no SAPL.
executivo.nota_en: Laws: the 203 ordinary and complementary laws dated from January 1, 2025 on in the City Council's SAPL system, whoever proposed them (the mayor's office signs almost all of them). Laws promulgated by the Council itself (type “Lei Promulgada” in SAPL) are left out. Vetoes: the veto messages (full or partial) the mayor's office sent to the City Council from January 1, 2025 on, as recorded in SAPL.
